name: boss-3
about: Boss Rush: Solvency Specter (a hooded wraith in tattered plate with an empty vault in its chest). Tripo H3.1 from concept boss03-specter-sd-0; rigged by Tripo (rig v1.0, biped); eight clips retargeted from Tripo's presets (two requests); parts from Tripo segmentation, each bound whole to the bone that owns it, so the armour stays rigid on a motion-captured skeleton.
